provenance.name: anchored-v4
provenance.note: Provisional anchoring to the published results of another machine (round robin 2022/2023, Bosch SMV6ECX51E, eco programme, detergent D; docs/research/standards.md section 7.1), to be replaced by washes on the owner's machine. Made on the water side "spotless-sim 0.4.1 water-5", sources sha256:34816aba7271f07506b07db21742b941def5dcbc719a27c597d2c9355be42205; valid for that water side only (anchors/scripts/check.ts). Reference detergent D at 20 g. soil.egg_yolk.rateRef (and soil.milk.rateRef with it) fitted to the six in-machine egg-yolk rates; the lags read off the same bench data; liq.xProtease fitted to the cutlery and glass class means and soil.bleachRate to the crockery class mean of the record, each through the calibration tool's likelihood of a group mean score. Everything else is the registry's default. See docs/calibration/anchoring.md.

supersededBy.why: made on water-5 with the soak circulated throughout; the prediction of the owner's wash 01 was registered with it (docs/calibration/owner-wash-01-prediction.md)
